fields.title: Product sync record
fields.description: One row per SKU in your catalogue, carrying the current price, availability and (in detailed mode) stock quantity and description, plus what changed since the last run. Sync your own store on `hasChanged` and read `changes` for the exact before/after values. Every type is nullable because which fields are populated depends on the mode and on whether the product still exists.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The SKU this record belongs to.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-bulk (bulk endpoint), S2-product-page (page fallback or detailed mode), or none.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was fetched.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failure rows (NOT_FOUND, INVALID_INPUT, BLOCKED_AFTER_RETRIES, UPSTREAM_SHAPE_CHANGED, EMPTY_RESULT).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

sku.title: SKU
sku.description: Blibli product SKU - the key to join against your own catalogue.

syncStatus.title: Sync status
syncStatus.description: OK when the product resolved. NOT_FOUND when neither the bulk endpoint nor the product page returned it, meaning the listing appears removed - consider unpublishing it in your store.

merchantCode.title: Seller code
merchantCode.description: Blibli merchant code of the seller.

price.title: Current price (IDR)
price.description: The price being charged now - the number to base your resale price on.

salePrice.title: Sale price (IDR)
salePrice.description: Sale price as Blibli reports it.

inStock.title: In stock
inStock.description: Whether the product is currently buyable. Available in both modes.

stockQuantity.title: Stock quantity
stockQuantity.description: Exact units available. Only populated in detailed mode - the bulk endpoint exposes availability as a boolean only.

stockLimitedThreshold.title: Low-stock threshold
stockLimitedThreshold.description: The level at which Blibli starts showing a low-stock warning. Detailed mode only.

isPreOrder.title: Pre-order
isPreOrder.description: Whether the item ships as a pre-order, which changes your fulfilment promise. Detailed mode only.

description.title: Description
description.description:
Product selling points with Blibli's \n
markup stripped, ready to paste into your own listing. Detailed mode only.

warrantyText.title: Warranty
warrantyText.description: Warranty statement, e.g. 'Garansi resmi 2 tahun'. Detailed mode only.

warrantyType.title: Warranty type
warrantyType.description: Warranty class, e.g. RESMI. Detailed mode only.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Category path for the product. Detailed mode only.

images.title: Images
images.description: All product images. Detailed mode only.

hasVariants.title: Has variants
hasVariants.description: Whether the listing has multiple variants, which may each carry their own price and stock.

changeType.title: Change type
changeType.description: What moved since the last run: NEW, UNCHANGED, PRICE_INCREASED, PRICE_DECREASED, OUT_OF_STOCK, BACK_IN_STOCK, NAME_CHANGED, BECAME_UNAVAILABLE, BECAME_AVAILABLE. Several can apply at once.

changes.title: Changes
changes.description: Per-field before/after values, e.g. {"price": {"from": 255000, "to": 239000, "deltaPercent": -6.27}}. This is what you push into your own store.

hasChanged.title: Has changed
hasChanged.description: True when anything moved since the last run. Filter on this to sync only what needs updating.
